title: The lowest price ever on the Canon EOS R6 II tops some of the best Black Friday camera deals we've seen today
summary: We have rounded up the best camera deals this Black Friday, including the lowest-ever price on one of our favorite low-light cameras, the Canon EOS R6 II.
contentText:
Camera deals have been a bit harder to find this Black Friday but we have found these great reductions on models we gave some of our highest ratings to. If you are in the market for a new camera , whether for astrophotography, general shooting or another particular style, one of these might fit the bill for your needs.

High-resolution models like the Sony A7R V and the Canon EOS R5 are great for those who need the most detail from their shots and a strong amount of pro-functionality. One of our low-light favorites has dropped to its lowest-ever price on Walmart thanks to this year's release of a new version. We loved the Canon EOS R6 II for its amazing high ISO noise handling and impressive -6.5 EV low-light autofocus, so despite the release of the EOS R6 III , this is still one of the best mirrorless cameras you can get for astrophotography.

Best Black Friday camera deals live right now

EOS R6 Mark II: was $2298 now $1713.95
Canon's low light beast is now at its cheapest price ever. It has a 24MP resolution sensor, 100-102,400 ISO and eight stops of in-body image stabilization.

We gave it 4/5 stars in our Canon EOS R6 II review. View Deal

The latest Z6 model from Nikon has a 24MP sensor, an ISO range of 100–64,000 and sharp autofocus.

We awarded its predecessor 4/5 stars in our full Nikon Z6 II review. View Deal

Even though aimed at producting video, this camera is still quite capable for astrophotography. It has a 24MP sensor, an ISO of ISO 100-32,000 and great autofocus.
